idea-plugin.name: AKS LTS & EKS Extended Support Lint for Terraform
idea-plugin.description:
Terraform EKS and AKS version check: sample clusters.tf on 2026-09-27 — $2,256 extra on EKS 1.32 since 2026-03-23, $3,660 on 1.31 since 2025-11-26, $5,916 total; 9 rules

Right-click in the editor (or Tools) → AKS LTS & EKS Extended Support Lint for Terraform: Check This File. Each finding appears on its line with the fix. 9 rules, offline. Runs the same engine as the VS Code extension and the CLI: npx @readystack/aks-eks-support-cliff-lint (Node.js 18+ required).

Free for the file you open. The whole-project sweep and the report need a licence ($29 once): getreadystack.com/tools/aks-eks-support-cliff-lint
